insights.summary: Spoken dates of birth and MRNs pass through transcripts unredacted while card numbers are masked.
insights.quote: Spoken dates of birth and MRNs are coming through in the transcripts completely unredacted. Card numbers get masked, but those don't.

insights.summary: Wants to choose which identifiers are redacted and lock the setting against regional admins.
insights.quote: We need to be able to choose which identifiers get redacted, and lock that setting so a regional admin can't turn it off.
